## About This Site

Health Is Wealth (healthiswealth.live) is an organic superfood supplement brand based in Marina Del Rey, California.
We sell ancestral superfoods validated by modern science — no pharmaceutical markup, no hype.
Our tagline: "Empowering Every Body — From Our Roots to Your Table."

## What We Sell

We specialize in the following organic superfood supplements:

- **Organic Moringa Powder** ($29.99) — Clean, caffeine-free energy with 90+ nutrients. Top keyword: moringa powder benefits.
- **Sea Moss Gummies** (~$25) — 92 minerals, thyroid support, gut healing. Top keyword: sea moss benefits.
- **Blue Spirulina Lemonade Powder** ($19.99) — Powerful antioxidants, phycocyanin, brain clarity. Top keyword: blue spirulina benefits.
- **Amla Powder** ($13.99) — 20x vitamin C vs. oranges, immune defense. Top keyword: amla powder vitamin C.
- **Manuka Honey MGO 263+** (~$35–$60) — Gut armor, antibacterial, prebiotic properties. Top keyword: manuka honey benefits.
- **Pure Shilajit Resin** (~$30–$50) — Testosterone support, mitochondrial energy. Top keyword: shilajit benefits men's health.
- **Chaga Mushroom Extract** (~$25) — Immune modulation, antioxidant support. Top keyword: chaga mushroom immune system.

The Power 5 Bundle includes all five core superfoods. Available at: https://healthiswealth.live/start

## Target Audience

Adults ages 25–45 interested in natural health, organic supplements, and ancestral wellness traditions.
Primary communities: Black, Latino, and multicultural wellness consumers in urban US markets.
Common pain points addressed: chronic fatigue, brain fog, poor immunity, high supplement costs.

## Editorial Standards

- All health claims use evidence-based language: "supports," not "treats" or "cures"
- No disease treatment claims (FDA compliant)
- All statements include appropriate disclaimers per FDA guidelines
- Articles cite scientific literature and peer-reviewed studies

## Compliance

These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration.
